name: Elias
description: A member of Eula's cleanup crew who picks up fallen bricks.

timeline.summary: A building collapses on Eula's cleanup crew and she shields them with a dome of misty light.
timeline.quote: Eula Blue, unwilling cleanup worker and self-trained shield mage, throws her hands over her head, a dome of pale, misty light forming around them
